Our Story

The Story

Built to Live In. Shared to Learn From.

We built the home we couldn't find.

Sustainabox started with a simple idea: could shipping containers become a beautiful, practical home without sacrificing comfort?

What followed was years of designing, building, documenting, and solving problems. Jen led the construction and documented every step of the journey. Cody designed the home in SketchUp and is focused on turning everything we learned into resources that help others build with confidence.

Today, Sustainabox is more than a container home. It's a place to stay, a place to learn, and a growing resource for anyone interested in container construction, resilient design, and intentional living.
